design_note: NDB begins FY2014, coincident with IFN-free DAA availability; no internal pre-intervention baseline, so a conventional pre/post ITS is not identifiable. Reported below are descriptive segmented and exponential trend models with HAC and bootstrap 95% intervals (n=10 annual observations).

daa_segmented.pre_peak_caution: The pre-peak segment is informed by only the observations up to the knot; with a knot in the second fiscal year this is a two-point increment, not an estimated trend, and its interval is correspondingly wide. Reported for completeness, not for interpretation as a rate.

combined_volume_segmented.pre_peak_caution: The pre-peak segment is informed by only the observations up to the knot; with a knot in the second fiscal year this is a two-point increment, not an estimated trend, and its interval is correspondingly wide. Reported for completeness, not for interpretation as a rate.

combined_volume_note: Segmented model on the combined estimated treatment volume (interferon-free DAA courses + peginterferon courses) from results/course_estimate.json. Estimates, not observed patient counts.

peginterferon_decay.fy_used_note: Fiscal years with positive dispensing; the series remains positive through the final fiscal year.

conventional_ifn_decay.fy_used_note: Fiscal years with positive dispensing; the series remains positive through the final fiscal year.

ribavirin_decay.fy_used_note: Fiscal years with published (non-suppressed) dispensing; from the following fiscal year onward the drug was below the NDB publication threshold (not listed or shown as '-').

censoring_upper_bound.note: Same models refitted to the upper-bound series in which every NDB cell that is unpublished (product outside the top-N of its class, or total shown as '-') is set to the largest value it could hide. Gives the least steep post-peak decline compatible with the publication rules; a bound, not an estimate.

daa_segmented.pre_peak_caution: The pre-peak segment is informed by only the observations up to the knot; with a knot in the second fiscal year this is a two-point increment, not an estimated trend, and its interval is correspondingly wide. Reported for completeness, not for interpretation as a rate.

combined_volume_segmented.pre_peak_caution: The pre-peak segment is informed by only the observations up to the knot; with a knot in the second fiscal year this is a two-point increment, not an estimated trend, and its interval is correspondingly wide. Reported for completeness, not for interpretation as a rate.

peginterferon_decay.fy_used_note: Fiscal years with positive dispensing; the series remains positive through the final fiscal year.

ribavirin_note: Ribavirin accompanied both peginterferon-based therapy and the interferon-free sofosbuvir + ribavirin regimen, so this decay rate describes the combined decline of both regimens and is not evidence about interferon-based therapy alone.
